summary: Tonewheel (Hammond-style) organ: gospel, reggae, funk, soul, house
label: organ
body: Gospel and soul chords; the reggae organ bubble (short off-beat chords); house organ stabs. Rock: GeneralUser GS/Rock Organ.

Register: MIDI 36-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Tonewheel Organ, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Tonewheel Organ") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
